description: You waited 13 years. Now get launch day off. TSG: Nice City is a free parody browser game: fake a cough or quit, outrun HR, the cops and the loan sharks, sneak past your fiancée and play first.

press.headline: A free parody game about getting GTA 6 launch day off work
press.about: TSG: Nice City is a free browser game from Too Soon Games, made for the launch of GTA 6 on November 19, 2026, thirteen years after GTA V. You play an ordinary fan who still has a job on launch day: call in sick or quit, outrun HR, the police or the loan sharks across a 90s-style city, get a day-one copy, sneak past your fiancée and get home to play first. It plays on any phone or computer with no signup, and every run ends on a global leaderboard. It is an unofficial parody, not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
facts: Free, no signup, plays in any mobile or desktop browser
Seven stages: three drives across one city, three mini-games, one password
Two ways past the boss (call in sick or quit) and three ways to pay at the store
Unofficial parody, not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two
Made by Too Soon Games, a small studio that turns the news into games
